# Vendor Libraries

This directory contains third-party libraries used by ScholarClaw.

## Contents

### fastapi-rbac
Role-based access control (RBAC) implementation for FastAPI.
- Used for: Policy gate, permission management
- Source: https://github.com/example/fastapi-rbac

### pytector
Prompt injection detection library.
- Used for: ArmorIQ guard, input sanitization
- Source: https://github.com/example/pytector

## Usage

These libraries are included as git submodules or direct copies.
Do not modify files in this directory directly.

## Updates

To update vendor libraries:
1. Pull latest from upstream
2. Test compatibility with ScholarClaw
3. Document any breaking changes
